definition: The controlled registry of formal MEDIAN terms, capitalization, meanings, owners, aliases and exclusions. It describes canon; it does not create canon by itself.
status: Provisional --- This document is the first assembled Namespace.

definition: Positive rules and definitions accepted as describing MEDIAN.
status: Settled --- Do not use design debate or historical rationale as world-facing canon.

definition: A working term or formulation that may be used for development but is not yet frozen.
status: Settled --- Provisional values and names must declare themselves.

definition: A numerical or implementation value that may change without altering the governing architecture.
status: Settled --- Never present tuning as immutable world law.

definition: A term canonical only within a named species, manifestation, interface or content contract.
status: Settled --- Its local authority must be stated.

definition: A concrete expression of MEDIAN in a medium, such as desktop/console, tabletop or the Concept Sourcebook.
status: Settled --- A manifestation may change interface and resolution while preserving core invariants.

definition: The art-forward, complete-feeling book manifestation of MEDIAN; designed to remain satisfying even without software production.
status: Settled --- Not merely a development binder.

definition: The sourcebook text that introduces the game in dependency order and explains why and how it works.
status: Settled --- Must remain understandable without appendices.

definition: Canonical lookup material too dense, repetitive, tabular or generative for the main reading flow.
status: Settled --- Positive canon only.

definition: Internal authorship, tuning, encounter-construction, manifestation or implementation material.
status: Settled --- Canonical only where explicitly marked.

definition: Provenance, migration, conflict, QA, build-state or rejected-option records kept outside the reader-facing game.
status: Settled --- Includes Migration Ledger, Source Manifest and build records.

definition: An ALL-CAPS canonical verb that relates a subject to a target and names a complete form of play or species spatial action.
status: Working --- Register operators: DWELL, TRAVEL, RISK, MEET, EMBODY. Species operators: JOIN, GATHER, CONNECT.

definition: A formal subject, object, state or category written with Initial Caps after it has been defined.
status: Working --- Capitalization marks an established distinction; it never substitutes for definition.

definition: The explicit daily accounting and information plate. It is uppercase by settled usage but is not an operator.
status: Settled --- Explicit exception to the normal ALL-CAPS operator rule.

definition: Design in which game logic creates the stable attention needed for one particular Home, population and history to become increasingly irreplaceable.
status: Working preferred --- Preferred current term. Normalize older "attachment-first" wording during compilation.

definition: The player attention and emotional room made possible after Game Logic has established legibility, competence and stability.
status: Working --- Not a meter, location or unlock.

definition: The credible systemic structure that lets the player understand, sustain and trust the Colony before attachment is asked to carry the experience.
status: Working --- Game Logic creates Attachment Space.

definition: Safety made materially and civically credible through stewardship, not merely asserted by tone or art direction.
status: Settled --- MEDIAN is about the creation, endangerment and experience of sanctuary.

definition: A stable Home state in which ordinary life, observation, voluntary Projects and EMBODY can occur without manufactured crisis.
status: Settled --- Closely related to Quiet Equilibrium but not a separate meter.

definition: The rule that new content should resolve through existing grammars before a new subsystem, currency, slot or action is created.
status: Working strong --- Mechanical restraint; expressive variety.

definition: The requirement that consequential state be accountable and readable without converting life into anonymous optimization.
status: Working --- Aphoristic title; final punctuation and subtitle remain editorial.

definition: Danger may wound, change or kill particular Citizens, but the design does not treat named lives as routine replaceable throughput.
status: Working strong --- Population growth is not tuned around routine casualties.

term: Home grows the Colony; Away grows the Citizen
definition: Home progression primarily changes collective civic capability; Away primarily hazards and changes particular Citizens.
status: Settled --- A concise governing line, not an absolute prohibition on cross-effects.

term: One world, two Modes, five Registers
definition: All play shares one persistent world state while Home and Away resolve different subjects through five forms of play.
status: Settled --- The Registers are not separate minigame universes.

definition: An animal-colony base-building game set in living median strips of active highways.
status: Settled --- Set in all caps as the title.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: One of the two broad simulation domains: Home or Away. A Mode identifies the primary subject and scale of mechanical attention.
status: Settled --- Home and Away are Initial Caps, not all-caps operators.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: Play in which the Colony is the principal crunch subject and the player builds, tends and stabilizes the permanent Home.
status: Settled --- Compact form: Home.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: Play in which particular Citizens and the expedition party become the principal crunch subjects beyond Home safety.
status: Settled --- Begins when Launch is executed; ends when Homecoming is received.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: A distinct form of play with characteristic action, decision, pace and indicative camera or presentation.
status: Settled --- A Register is a mode of attention, not merely a camera.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: A particular presentation inside a Register that does not alter the player's fundamental relation to subject, time and control.
status: Settled --- Launch, Homecoming, Stopover and Staging are Views or connectors, not Registers.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: Build, tend, sustain and shape the Colony at Home.
status: Settled --- Indicative camera: elevated three-quarter strategy view; not a sectional/cutaway default.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: Read routes, reveal territory and carry an expedition through extended Away space.
status: Settled --- TRAVEL reveals territory; it does not produce Knowledge points.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: Resolve immediate committed spatial danger, principally Crossing the Highway.
status: Settled --- Crossing is the world situation; RISK is the form of play.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: Turn a bounded condition in the world into a consequential choice the player must answer.
status: Settled --- Cross-modal: available in Home and Away.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: Experience ordinary animal life made possible by sanctuary through a bounded, intimate, bodily scene at Home.
status: Settled --- Home-only; not general free-roam or a second optimization game.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: Mouse civilizational action: make Places belong through enclosure, adjacency, contact and continuous protected passage.
status: Settled --- Mouse spatial grammar.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: Rabbit civilizational action: make Places belong through shared ground, mutual visibility, frontage and collective movement.
status: Settled --- Rabbit spatial grammar.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: Squirrel civilizational action: make Places belong through routes, redundancy, reachability and non-isolated nodes.
status: Settled --- Squirrel spatial grammar.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: The permanent named civilization at Home: its Citizens, Places, stores, obligations, institutions and remembered history.
status: Settled --- The Home crunch subject.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: A named person with equal civic standing, persistent identity, relationships, history and consequence.
status: Settled --- Core and Guest Citizens share one Citizen architecture.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: One roster-counted civic person; normally one body, with two explicitly authorized collective-bodied Guest exceptions.
status: Settled --- Do not substitute body units for named population.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: The fixed group of Citizens whose Launch has been executed and who resolve Away travel and situations collectively.
status: Settled --- Party membership does not expand mid-Expedition.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: A bounded departure from Home by a fixed party, including Launch, Away travel and situations, Return and Homecoming.
status: Settled --- Citizens leave because they belong.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: A player-selected way the party or Colony attempts to answer the current MEET situation.
status: Settled --- The Approach exists before Tool, Supply or Focus expression.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: One resolved choice within a MEET.
status: Settled --- Focus is reevaluated by Turn.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: A bounded authored situation resolved through MEET.
status: Settled --- Do not use Encounter as the name of the Register; the Register is MEET.
section: Modes, Registers, Views and Core Subjects

definition: The one continuous road environment along which Home, Reaches, routes, Crossings, outposts and the Metropolis are situated.
status: Settled --- The campaign expands outward without relocating its center.

definition: The founding median strip that permanently contains the player's Home Colony.
status: Settled --- Never superseded by a better map or frontier base.

definition: Active vehicle lanes that divide median territory from the Margins and create RISK.
status: Settled --- The Highway is not post-human ruin; it is active infrastructure.

definition: Road-edge territory beyond the Highway, explored Away and distinct from Home.
status: Settled --- Reserve bare "Margin" for geography; use Readiness Margin for civic headroom.

definition: An extended corridor territory read and revealed through TRAVEL.
status: Settled --- Compact reminder may use Reach after first definition.

definition: The Away territory through which the party travels and where Nodes and routes are revealed.
status: Settled --- Not a separate Register; TRAVEL is the Register.

definition: An authored location encountered in the Field; arrival may open MEET when it contains a bounded consequential situation.
status: Settled --- Not a research object, progress bar or unlock container.

definition: A persistent or situational fact used to select or alter MEET content at a Node.
status: Settled --- May vary by Day Band, season, weather, relationships, prior choices and material state.

definition: A traversable connection between locations whose condition, safety and knowledge may change through play.
status: Settled --- Route state is direct world state, not abstract Knowledge.

definition: A committed passage across active Highway lanes, resolved primarily through RISK.
status: Settled --- Use Initial Cap in prose; RISK is the all-caps operator.

definition: A durable refuge, cache, Watch or low-Care point established along the corridor.
status: Settled --- Remains Away; does not support DWELL or EMBODY as a second Colony.

definition: A bounded refuge or halt used to end a leg, rest, receive low Care, Watch or access stored material.
status: Settled --- A View or function, not a Register.

definition: The corridor's major distant civic destination and social concentration.
status: Settled form provisional --- Preferred current spelling has no hyphen; older documents use Rest-Stop Metropolis.

definition: A later connected settlement that may emerge along the corridor without replacing the founding Home.
status: Provisional --- Architectural permission settled; detailed implementation deferred.

definition: Human roadside barrier forming an extreme corridor edge and ecological surface.
status: Provisional carry-forward --- Exact cross-section remains a world-reference authoring task.

definition: The rendered environmental setting behind a MEET, reflecting current place, Day Band and relevant world conditions.
status: Scoped --- Presentation term; not a world object.

definition: Human road infrastructure is experienced by the animals as terrain, climate, route, shelter and danger rather than as decorative ruin.
status: Working --- An interpretive doctrine, not a resource type.

definition: A bounded area of land the player explicitly claims or selects for building.
status: Settled --- Stores location, footprint, species-spatial fit and condition.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: What an acquired or developed Place does for the Colony.
status: Settled --- The active civic purpose or function of a Place.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: A defined change executed through the Construction Queue using relevant resources and committed Citizen time.
status: Settled --- Changes a specific Place or persistent fact; never globally levels all Places.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Direct eligibility to begin a named Project or adopt a named Practice, created by Tier, MEET, Metropolis relationship or world event.
status: Settled --- Not a currency or research point.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: The shared process for deliberate, defined, persistent work that commits a related Role, resources and time.
status: Settled --- One active entry per related Role; different Roles may work concurrently.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: A share of current civic responsibility held by a present and available adult Citizen.
status: Settled --- Not a class, aptitude score or lifelong career.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: One equal civic share contributed by each present, available adult Citizen assigned to a Role.
status: Settled --- Guest and Core Citizens contribute equally.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Available Role Capacity within a named civic responsibility.
status: Settled with usage rule --- Prefer the full form Role Capacity at first use; avoid confusion with Carry.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: The civic responsibility created by population, Places, conditions, absence, season and expansion that must be covered by relevant Role Capacity.
status: Settled --- Contextual and global, not per-building throughput.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Capacity remaining after ordinary Load is covered, representing redundancy, ambition or response room.
status: Settled preferred --- Use the full compound; bare Margin is geographic.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: The Colony's legible posture when relevant capacities, Places and preparations can answer current ordinary responsibilities.
status: Settled --- Not a universal percentage buff.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: A named uncovered civic shortfall that may create vulnerability and, when consequential, become a Home MEET.
status: Settled --- Do not manufacture repetitive chores merely to display Deficiency.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: A credible Colony-wide condition in which ordinary Load is covered and no acute situation demands attention, enabling EMBODY and voluntary life.
status: Settled --- Not permanent invulnerability.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: A bounded DWELL action that represents meaningful Colony time and changes persistent Colony state.
status: Settled --- Completing one normally advances a full Day Band.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Passive preparation that keeps recurring consumable or preserved things ready using uncommitted Role Capacity and appropriate Places or Practices.
status: Settled --- Distinct from the Construction Queue.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Caretaker transformation of Perishable Sustenance into Durable Sustenance where conditions permit.
status: Settled --- No separate preservation currency.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Crafter transformation of appropriate stocks into prepared Supplies.
status: Settled --- Governed by available Capacity, Place, Practice and material.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: The Colony's held material and Sustenance stocks and the Places that protect them.
status: Settled --- Use specific stock names where mechanical distinction matters.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: A Place that credibly houses named Citizens and contributes to the Colony's supported population and Load.
status: Settled --- Residence is not anonymous housing capacity alone.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: A Residence that also embodies the care, margin and support required for dependents or young Citizens.
status: Settled --- The Nursery is one expression, not a population factory.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: A visible Residence adapted through both Core-species spatial grammar and a Guest's bodily requirements.
status: Settled --- Not a consumed recruitment slot.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: The principal cultural and ceremonial Place where the Colony interprets its life through Laws, Sayings, stories, ceremonies, memorials and Tier recognition.
status: Settled --- Replaces Circle as the generic cross-species term.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: The single active display position within the Gathering Place for one eligible Special Artifact.
status: Settled --- Its effect is grounded in shared story and civic meaning, not an aura.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: A Place supporting Colony-scale deliberation, coordination and consequential civic MEETs.
status: Settled --- May coincide with or sit within the Gathering Place depending on species expression.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: A cultivated Place supporting green-season food and ecological stewardship.
status: Settled --- Winter behavior depends on learned Winter Cultivation and a specific Project.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: A learned Practice that allows an adapted Garden to produce limited Perishable Sustenance during winter.
status: Settled --- Eligible by Tier, learned through authored MEET, embodied by Project.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: A particular Garden physically adapted by Project to carry the Winter Cultivation Practice.
status: Settled --- Not a global upgrade to all Gardens.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: A Practice whose eligibility follows Tier advancement and whose learning occurs through authored Colony or Metropolis MEET.
status: Settled --- Learning is direct; no Knowledge currency.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Covers ordinary structural Load and supports construction, reinforcement and major restoration Projects.
status: Settled --- Role name.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Covers household, store, dependent and ordinary preservation responsibilities.
status: Settled --- Owns Preservation Provisioning.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Provides warning, route oversight and early detection.
status: Settled --- Not a generic combat class.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Coordinates civic decisions, social strain and Colony-scale action.
status: Settled --- Supports Tier recognition and emergency mobilization.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Sustains cultivation, seasonal plant health and Garden Practices.
status: Settled --- Required for Winter Garden Project and coverage.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Maintains ordinary Tools and prepares Supplies or defined material components.
status: Settled --- Owns Supply Preparation and Tool-making Projects.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Provides patient care, treatment and recovery support through appropriate Places and existing stocks.
status: Provisional retained --- No separate Medicine stock survives; exact Home treatment grammar should normalize to Sustenance, Remedy and materials.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: Sustains cultural transmission, memory, newcomer integration and teaching Practices.
status: Settled --- Does not create a Knowledge resource.
section: Home Civic Systems, Roles and Places

definition: One shared world day resolved through DAWN and four playable Day Bands.
status: Settled --- Home and Away share this clock.

definition: One of Morning, Midday, Evening or Night.
status: Settled --- Each band contains two underlying Away Time Marks.

definition: The non-playable information and accounting plate that advances the calendar, consumes Sustenance and resolves daily systems.
status: Settled --- Leads directly into Morning.

definition: The first playable band after DAWN.
status: Settled --- Its Highway condition is Morning Rush.

definition: The second playable band.
status: Settled --- Its Highway condition is Midday Window.

definition: The third playable band.
status: Settled --- Its Highway condition is Evening Rush.

definition: The fourth playable band before the next DAWN.
status: Settled --- Its Highway condition is Night Velocity.

definition: One half of a Day Band used to resolve Away distance and duration.
status: Settled --- Meaningful TRAVEL leg or Brief MEET: one; Extended MEET: two.

definition: A meaningful segment of route progress that normally consumes one Time Mark.
status: Settled --- Rabbit parties make twice normal TRAVEL progress within the same Mark.

definition: A bounded situation whose represented duration consumes one Time Mark.
status: Settled --- Most uncontested MEETs are Brief.

definition: A situation whose represented duration consumes two Time Marks, normally a full Day Band.
status: Settled --- Most contested MEETs are Extended.

definition: The Crossing traffic condition corresponding to Morning.
status: Settled --- Not the name of the Day Band.

definition: The Crossing traffic condition corresponding to Midday.
status: Settled --- Not a universal world-time label.

definition: The Crossing traffic condition corresponding to Evening.
status: Settled --- Not the name of the Day Band.

definition: The Crossing traffic condition corresponding to Night.
status: Settled --- Night is not automatically safer merely because traffic is thinner.

definition: The current authored traffic behavior used by Crossing/RISK.
status: Settled --- Rush, Window and Velocity belong to the Highway.

definition: A broad environmental condition that changes circumstances, topology, demands and content through existing systems.
status: Settled --- No separate seasonal minigame or currency.

definition: A changing environmental condition expressed through route state, Place demands, Exposure, RISK and MEET content.
status: Settled --- Changes circumstances, not the grammar of play.

definition: An authored state-changing situation with meaningful player response and persistent consequences.
status: Settled --- Not a generic event-deck texture layer.

definition: The readable sign that a consequential condition is developing or approaching.
status: Settled --- May be delivered through ordinary world behavior rather than countdown UI.

definition: The moment the condition materially reaches play.
status: Settled --- May or may not immediately open a full MEET.

definition: The continuing world state left active after Impact.
status: Settled --- Must remain owned by the world, not only by an event card.

definition: The consequences, recovery and memory that follow resolution.
status: Settled --- Homecoming is a major aftermath carrier for Away events.

definition: Routine facts remain visible in the Register that naturally produces them until they cross the threshold for consequential attention.
status: Settled --- MEET is not used merely to announce every changing number.

definition: The point at which an ordinary condition becomes consequential enough to require focused player choice, usually through MEET.
status: Settled --- Prevents both silent consequence and event spam.

definition: The Home MEET and commitment through which party membership and Supply assignments are confirmed and departure is executed.
status: Settled --- Before execution it may be cancelled; after execution Away state is fixed.

definition: The party's inward movement toward Home after its outward work.
status: Settled --- Does not itself restore Home Mode.

definition: The existing MEET process through which the Colony receives the returning party, unloads consequences and recalculates civic posture.
status: Settled --- A full-band Home Commitment; no separate aftermath subsystem.

definition: The authored Home MEET that resolves return, immediate treatment, arrivals, losses, Cargo and persistent expedition consequences.
status: Settled --- Includes disposition of a deceased Citizen's latent Keepsake.

definition: Accumulated personal pressure and possibility created through Away danger; higher Exposure widens the range toward both distinction and catastrophe.
status: Settled --- Not a generic hit-point meter; it may ebb in credible sanctuary.

definition: A context-tagged lasting memory created by Exposure that may intensify recurrence but can soften through safety, relationship and lived experience.
status: Settled --- History remains even when mechanical sharpness softens.

definition: A narrow, positive, event-grounded capability or recognition arising from what a Citizen endured or accomplished.
status: Settled --- Not a generic achievement buff or level gain.

definition: A serious bodily consequence that changes what a Citizen cannot easily do.
status: Settled --- Paired conceptually with Distinction, not as a symmetrical reward table.

definition: A rare public byname granted when defining history becomes part of a Citizen's recognized identity.
status: Settled --- No automatic stat effect and no first-Distinction automation.

definition: A severe break in a Citizen's capacity to continue coherent action under terror or Exposure.
status: Settled --- Not merely high damage or an ordinary fear penalty.

definition: The extreme circumstance in which a Citizen is permanently left Away while tharn.
status: Settled but rare --- Handled as permanent loss, not routine attrition.

definition: The situational selection of the Citizen whose camera, principal action, speech and consequential prose carry one Turn.
status: Settled --- The party resolves; Focus decides whose life the moment belongs to.

definition: The persistent authored identification of what or whose history the whole MEET concerns.
status: Settled --- Distinct from Turn-by-Turn Focus.

definition: Rabbit advantage in reading and exploiting traffic windows, acceleration, redirection and recovery during RISK.
status: Settled principle --- Exact presentation and tuning belong to the future Crossing specification.

definition: The movement profile used by the entire party, determined by the campaign's Core Species.
status: Settled --- Guest locomotion differences remain diegetic and do not alter party pace.

definition: Food stock consumed at DAWN and used where food or recovery costs are mechanically relevant.
status: Settled --- Typed as Perishable or Durable only when function requires.

definition: All living named Citizen subjects who belong to the Colony, regardless of current presence or availability.

definition: A close domestic and relational unit recognized by the Colony and relevant to Residence, care, nesting, memory and succession.

definition: A Citizen belonging to another Citizen's Hearth; the eligible recipient class for a deceased Citizen's returned Keepsake.
status: Settled --- Hyphenated canonical form.

definition: A displaced or traveling member of the Core Species who becomes an ordinary Core Citizen upon acceptance.

definition: The Place that houses and supports a player-authorized seasonal cycle of young Citizens.
